title: documents.php extract response
description: 200 for action=extract. Either the outcome of a run through the sidecar (status extracted or failed, with what was persisted and the supervisor's handoffs), or a short form with already=true when the document had been extracted before (nothing runs again). A sidecar transport failure is 502 with documents.error.response (reason, document_id, status=stored) and the file can be retried.

oneOf.description: The document was run through the sidecar in this request.

failure_reason.description: Why the last extraction failed, a fixed code from run.response (encrypted, unreadable, too_many_pages, model_error, schema_mismatch, timeout) or a sidecar transport code (unavailable, timeout); null when stored or extracted.

confidence.description: Share of extracted fields the anchor step could prove; a number after a run, possibly null on the already-extracted short form.

results_persisted.description: Lab results or intake items written to the chart with citations.

unverified.description: Proposed values the anchor step could not find on the page; surfaced as extraction_unverified facts.

unextracted.description: Printed result rows the model did not propose; surfaced as extraction_unverified facts.

correlation_id.description: Correlation id of the request; quote it when reporting a problem.
